works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: neobrutalism 银行 App：粗黑字 + 贴纸元素 + 彩虹开支环，转账兑换的大卡片布局可抄。
works.comment_en: Neobrutalist banking app: heavy black type, sticker elements, and a rainbow spending ring — the big-card layout for transfers and FX is worth stealing.
works.title: Bank App - Account Balance Overview

works.author: Artspire
works.comment: 深色 hero 配流体 3D 背景，首屏挂媒体背书条，Agency 落地页的经典打法。
works.comment_en: Dark hero with a fluid 3D background and a press-logo bar up top — the classic agency landing-page playbook.
works.title: Web3 Agency Website Design

works.author: Samuel Oktavianus
works.comment: 爆炸图蓝图风画实验设备，硬核产品落地页的讲法很值钱。
works.comment_en: Exploded-view blueprint style for lab equipment — a valuable way to pitch hardcore products on landing pages.
works.title: ordivalabs: Biotech Autonomous Laboratory Website - Hero UI

works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 青色系保健品 DTC：产品 3D 渲染 + 功效文案 + 价格条，"Shop Now" 一屏闭环。
works.comment_en: Teal-toned supplement DTC: product 3D renders, benefit copy, and a price bar — a one-screen 'Shop Now' loop.
works.title: Health Supplements Shopping Mobile App Design

works.author: Linkup ST
works.comment: 诊所自助签到 Kiosk：大字欢迎 + 单一主按钮，公共终端的减法设计。
works.comment_en: Clinic self-check-in kiosk: big welcome type plus a single primary button — subtractive design for public terminals.
works.title: InnoHealth – AI-Powered Healthcare Kiosk & Website UI/UX Design

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 暗黑税务合规驾驶舱："有效税率桥"图表把复杂调账讲清了，财报类 dashboard 的信息密度排布值得看。
works.comment_en: Dark tax-compliance cockpit: the 'effective tax rate bridge' chart makes complex reconciliations legible — worth studying for financial-report dashboard density.
works.title: Tax Compliance Software Web App Design
